parsed.explanation: Combined regime: national entry/document rules create traveler-facing refusal, confiscation and possible permanent fraud ineligibility on mismatch, plus birth-sex facility and custody harms; the state adds a schools/colleges birth-certificate facility law with no enforcement mechanism or criminal penalty, uncertain minor-care/sports bans, and patchy local protections. Courts litigate but have not stopped key national policies, and national custody abuse and threat-framing raise severity if detained. No criminalisation of trans identity or credible execution, but exclusion, stranding and institutional misplacement are documented universal exposures.

entry_documents.exposure: Passport X stopped Feb 2025, Supreme Court allowed restrictions Nov 2025; entry cable directs refusal on document discrepancy and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation; passports confiscated/blocked, travellers stranded.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiry; fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic, limited waivers; civil-liberties suit pending.
entry_documents.interaction: Mismatch at entry can escalate to refusal, detention and custody placement, interacting with national document regime for any visitor.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections policy from 2026: hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric substitution; immigration custody reports of forced labour, beatings, solitary and sexual abuse of trans men.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No traveller-specific custody protection documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Document discrepancy or facility trespass can lead to detention where birth-sex placement and reported abuse increase severity.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National EO bars gender-identity facilities in government-funded single-sex facilities; state Protect All Students Act requires schools/colleges use facilities per birth certificate, public and private.
federal_state_facilities.protection: State law has single-occupancy exemption, no enforcement mechanism and no criminal penalty; no documented arrest under it; many states have no mapped ban, but this state is among ban states.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: General adult visitor exposure limited to schools/colleges, but traveller with minor encounters school designation, outing law and possible refusal.

care_services.exposure: State Act bans puberty blockers, hormones and surgery under 18; nationally proposed rules would bar public insurance for under-18 care; national EO frames care as mutilation.
care_services.protection: State Act blocked Apr 2024, allowed Aug 2024, re-enjoined 18 Mar 2025; adult-care perpetual-counselling rules dropped Feb 2024.
care_services.interaction: Uncertain enforceability affects travelling minors and guardians seeking care; adult visitor care denial not documented for this state.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National counterterrorism strategy prioritises radically pro-transgender groups; DOJ memo uses radical gender ideology framing; 66% poll support for birth-sex documents; bills and funding directives target gender ideology.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Hate crimes punishable nationally; courts have enjoined several orders; national employment ruling protects against trans discrimination.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Framing raises probability of institutional hostility at borders, schools and facilities despite judicial injunctions.

minors_guardians.exposure: School staff must out LGBTQ students to parents and ban undefined gender ideology K-3 from Jan 2025; school facility law; national EO directs prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition; sports and care bans for minors.
minors_guardians.protection: Care/sports Act re-enjoined, status unresolved; no documented traveller family protection.
minors_guardians.interaction: A minor visitor's enrolment, facilities, disclosure to parents/guardians and care access interact across state and national rules; guardians may face investigation exposure as schools report.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No trans-specific street violence rate documented for state; national bias incidents 1/7 to 1/5 of hate incidents; transit/screening outing risk documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: 33 cities/counties bar gender-identity discrimination in employment, housing and public accommodations; state employment EO since 2018.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Patchy local protections do not cancel national entry/facility enforcement; police response to trans victims not_documented for this state.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Only 23 states cover gender identity in bias statutes; state has no gender-identity discrimination statute for private employment/housing/public accommodations; Aug 2026 licence marker rules final text and challenge not sourced.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Passport suit, challenges to EOs, court rulings on birth-certificate corrections since 2021, and local ordinances provide some recourse.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Recourse exists but is slow, uneven by county, and has not reversed passport or entry policies; functioning courts enforce hostile policies as well as rights.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar in that exclusion/refusal and humiliation rather than imprisonment dominate, with ineffective appeals; this case is somewhat higher because state facility law lacks enforcement and entry fraud finding is not automatic, lower than pure exclusion because custody abuse severity is documented.

Lower than 0.55: secondary screening there is usually administrative refusal with appeal desk, whereas here mismatch can trigger refusal, confiscation, stranding and consideration of permanent lifetime ineligibility, plus national custody abuse.

Far lower than 0.75: there border training and tribunal release end detention briefly, while here Supreme Court allowed passport restrictions, entry cable directs refusal, and no equivalent traveller remedy is documented as operating.

parsed.synthesis: National document/entry regime is the operative universal exposure: binary sex, X removal, discrepancy refusal and fraud consideration can strand or permanently bar a visitor, and any detention risks documented birth-sex custody abuse. The state adds school/college birth-certificate facilities and outing duties, but with no enforcement mechanism or criminal penalty, and its minor care/sports law is enjoined with uncertain status. Local ordinances, employment rulings and litigation provide partial recourse, yet courts have not restored passports and institutions enforce hostile rules. Hence severe institutional exclusion without execution or likely imprisonment for identity alone.
